correctness.rationale: Universal proof partitions a partial permutation into directed paths and cycles, controls completion sign by (-1)^{n-c-t}, proves parity robustness for at least four remaining paths (r=4 matching-count bound, r=5 exhaustive 120 forbidden permutations, r>=6 K2,2 parity switch plus Hall), and exactly analyzes the three-path and two-path cases and n-1 obstruction. The cycle-refined path/cycle enumerator counts ordered path pairs and divides by two. Actual standalone code path verify_even_derangements.py exhaustively agrees with direct Boolean traces for 52,160 supports across n=4..7, tests all relevant small parity configurations, computes coefficients through n=14, and tests extremal completions. Computations are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The unsolved rank-(n-2) edge-query support classification for the natural even derangement family is a precise mathematically motivated missing boundary case. The two-path length/cycle-parity rule and exact factorial/EGF top coefficient hold at every order and complete an otherwise previously known full polynomial. The new result is structural, not a routine numerical increment, and remains substantive even though the lower-rank near-top law and one order-six coefficient were already established.
